label: Human check
instruction: Choose the right ending of the saying.
checkingLonger: Checking without a question. This takes a little longer…
wrong: Not quite. Here is a new question.
expired: The check expired. Here is a new question.
unreachable: The CAPTCHA service cannot be reached. Try again later.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
failed: The check could not be completed.
reported: Thank you. Someone will check this question.
reportFailed: The report could not be sent.
